svg.title: ISDS Thematic Watcher — how the whole thing works
svg.text: WHERE WE LOOK — THE 9 SOURCES, CHECKED EVERY RUN

g.title: ICSID — official case docket evidence: src/sources/icsid.py
italaw — award archive evidence: src/sources/italaw.py
IISD ITN — treaty news journal evidence: src/sources/iisd_itn.py
IAReporter — headlines only (paywalled) evidence: src/sources/iareporter_headlines.py
UNCTAD — UN case database evidence: src/sources/unctad_isds.py
PCA — court press releases evidence: src/sources/pca_press.py
Google Alerts — keyword alerts (feeds quiet lately) evidence: src/sources/google_alerts.py
Scholar Alerts — new academic papers evidence: src/sources/gmail_scholar.py
Bing News — keyword news search evidence: src/sources/bing_news.py

g.text: A scheduled timer starts the whole
GitHub Actions schedule, set by Emory
g.title:
Runs by itself every Monday — A scheduled timer starts the whole pipeline — nobody has to remember.
evidence: • .github/workflows/weekly.yml: cron '0 13 * * 1'

g.text: Pulls this week's listings from all 9
g.title:
Collect everything new — Pulls this week's listings from all 9 sources above into one pile.
evidence: • src/sources/__init__.py: all_sources() • src/main.py: fetch loop

g.text: A memory file remembers every item ever
seen, so nothing is processed twice.
g.title:
Skip repeats — A memory file remembers every item ever seen, so nothing is processed twice.
evidence: • src/state.py: seen-state • state/seen.json

First scoring pass — Counts legal key-phrases (the three 'rings') for a quick relevance score.
evidence: • src/classify.py: keyword_score • fingerprint.yaml

g.text: Fetches each promising item and pulls out
g.title:
Read the document — Fetches each promising item and pulls out its single most quotable line.
evidence: • src/enrich.py: enrich(), notable_quote()

g.text: Claude reads each item and scores its
relevance to the research question, with
g.title:
AI relevance check — Claude reads each item and scores its relevance to the research question, with reasons.
evidence: • src/classify.py: classify_item • prompts/classifier.txt

g.text: Near-misses (25+) may fill a quiet week,
g.title:
Quality bar — Items scoring 40+ enter the digest. Near-misses (25+) may fill a quiet week, always labeled as leads.
evidence: • src/main.py: select_surfaced() • src/config.py: threshold 40 / floor 25

g.text: Ask for a page to be read
The daily review session cannot reach the
internet at all, so it writes down the
Starts by itself when a request lands
g.title:
Ask for a page to be read — The daily review session cannot reach the internet at all, so it writes down the address it needs.
evidence: • analytics/fetch-requests/README.md: the request format and its rules • .github/workflows/fetch-relay.yml: push on analytics/fetch-requests/**

g.text: A separate run reads the page as politely
as the weekly run does, then sends back
If the test link fails, nothing counts
g.title:
Only a summary comes back — A separate run reads the page as politely as the weekly run does, then sends back 400 characters — never the page.
evidence: • scripts/fetch_relay.py: polite_get, 400-character excerpt, sha256 + byte length • scripts/fetch_relay.py: CONTROL_URL — a failed control voids the whole batch

g.text: Each day's meeting record, emailed to
g.title:
Daily research email — Each day's meeting record, emailed to Emory with the numbers-of-record banner.
evidence: • scripts/send_daily_update.py • .github/workflows/daily-update.yml

g.text: The annotated reading list of this week's
g.title:
Weekly digest email — The annotated reading list of this week's finds — sent to Dr. Benavides.
evidence: • src/email_send.py: send_digest • src/render.py

Public website — The digest archive and methodology, published automatically to the project site.
evidence: • scripts/build_site.py • .github/workflows/site-sync.yml

g.text: interpretation of the week — sent to Dr.
g.title:
Research brief email — The review stages' plain-English interpretation of the week — sent to Dr. Benavides.
evidence: • src/render.py: render_research_brief • src/main.py: brief email step

g.text: and grades, workflow ideas, the state of
the answer, and claims needing his check.
g.title:
Monday review packet — Emory's Monday briefing: session minutes and grades, workflow ideas, the state of the answer, and claims needing his check.
evidence: • scripts/send_human_review.py • scripts/review_prep.py

g.text: Runs daily: works the open questions, logs
every genuinely new sourced insight, plus
g.title:
Daily researcher — Runs daily: works the open questions, logs every genuinely new sourced insight, plus at most one improvement idea.
evidence: • analytics/daily-research/ • prompts/council_roundtable.txt

g.text: Sets the weekly agenda from the open
questions and directs where the analyst
g.title:
Chairman — Sets the weekly agenda from the open questions and directs where the analyst spends effort.
evidence: • src/research_brief.py: _run_chairman • prompts/council_chairman.txt

g.text: Interprets the week against the research
g.title:
Analyst — Interprets the week against the research question with bounded web research; proposes claims with exact quotes.
evidence: • src/research_brief.py: _run_analyst • prompts/research_analyst.txt

g.text: Studies the instrument itself and proposes
one sourced improvement at a time.
g.title:
Systems researcher — Studies the instrument itself and proposes one sourced improvement at a time.
evidence: • prompts/systems_researcher.txt • analytics/optimization-log.md

g.text: Writes the reader-facing brief. May state
as fact only what survived the gates.
g.title:
Editor — Writes the reader-facing brief. May state as fact only what survived the gates.
evidence: • src/research_brief.py: _run_editor • prompts/research_editor.txt

g.text: The chairman reviews each member's week on
the record: status, grades, next steps,
g.title:
Meeting minutes — The chairman reviews each member's week on the record: status, grades, next steps, escalations to Emory.
evidence: • src/research_brief.py: _run_reconvene • src/council_log.py

g.text: The cumulative 'State of the Answer' and
every open question feed next Monday's
g.title:
The living memory — The cumulative 'State of the Answer' and every open question feed next Monday's agenda — research compounds.
evidence: • src/research_state.py: record_issue, gap counters • state/research_log.json

g.text: Each claim is checked against its original
source. Emory confirms or rejects it — the
g.title:
Emory verifies facts — Each claim is checked against its original source. Emory confirms or rejects it — the system cannot verify facts itself.
evidence: • scripts/verify.py: mark • HANDOFF.md: chat-verification convention

g.text: A permanent record of every claim and its
status. Events are only ever added, so
g.title:
Verified-facts ledger — A permanent record of every claim and its status. Events are only ever added, so nothing can be quietly rewritten.
evidence: • analytics/verification_ledger.jsonl • scripts/verify.py: operator-only enforcement

g.text: Code looks up every claim in the ledger by
exact ID. Unverified ones must be labeled
g.title:
Claim gate (automatic) — Code looks up every claim in the ledger by exact ID. Unverified ones must be labeled leads; rejected ones are blocked.
evidence: • src/integrity_gate.py: exact claim-id lookup

g.text: A checking program opens every cited link
to confirm it exists and is reachable;
unlinked citations are flagged for Emory.
g.title:
Citation check (automatic) — A checking program opens every cited link to confirm it exists and is reachable; unlinked citations are flagged for Emory.
evidence: • scripts/check_citations.py • src/research_brief.py: _verify_citations

g.text: Vets every memo for fabrication, overreach
g.title:
Integrity officer — Vets every memo for fabrication, overreach and inflation; objections binding. Trained on the calibration checklist.
evidence: • prompts/council_security.txt • .claude/agents/integrity-officer.md

g.text: Ties findings to screened items; source
g.title:
Analytics officer — Ties findings to screened items; source receptivity with copied numbers. Trained on the numbers-of-record rule.
evidence: • prompts/council_roundtable.txt • .claude/agents/analytics-officer.md

g.text: Keeps the vault's memory current: agent
g.title:
Obsidian archivist — Keeps the vault's memory current: agent registry, change log, drift audits. Trained on the vault's conventions.
evidence: • .claude/agents/obsidian-archivist.md

g.text: tested. Trained on this repo's guards.
g.title:
Systems designer — Builds the machinery: renderers, validators, pipelines — fail-closed, tested. Trained on this repo's guards.
evidence: • .claude/agents/systems-designer.md

g.text: emails and the README. Trained on the
g.title:
Site experience — Owns the professor-facing website, the emails and the README. Trained on the site's templates.
evidence: • .claude/agents/site-experience.md • scripts/build_site.py

g.text: the machine moving items — through scoring and into the review stages
the machine delivering — the digest email and public site
review stages producing — hand-offs, the brief, minutes, Emory’s packet
moving dots = work flowing right now · box colors = who does it:
